title: 安波節（1番・本調子の基礎練習）
author: Traditional; newly entered elementary study by Music Stack
source: https://ks-sanshin.com/youtubeチャンネルに「安波節」を追加しました♪～歌/
scope: Traditional first stanza, two matching upper/lower-phrase cycles. Honchoshi C–F–C; one cell per beat, omitted small ornaments and vocal Hari inflections, two-beat final note. A new practice rendering, not a recording transcription.

rights_basis.source: https://ks-sanshin.com/youtubeチャンネルに「安波節」を追加しました♪～歌/
rights_basis.fact: The performing teacher identifies the song as handed down in Aha, Kunigami and used for celebrations. A 1993 Ryukyu University teaching paper p265 independently shows the same basic traditional contour and explains its beginner suitability.

comparison_sources.use: Basic contour comparison; modern vocal inflections, layout and translation excluded.

changes: New symbolic entry of common large-note contour. Omit small intra-cell notes; repeat the basic cycle for the lower couplet as indicated by the traditional lower-couplet instruction. Align first words to the preceding sounding cell at beats8/61 rather than a vocal onset on rest9/62. New original readings, easy meanings and vocabulary. Equal beats do not reproduce a teacher performance.
lyrics: Traditional first stanza only, separately attributed preset song:aha. Readings are an example; regional variations exist. No modern translation copied.
